Q1: The hazard profile for 1,1,1,2-tetrachloro-2-fluoroethane indicates a potential hazard for dermal and eye exposure (Tier 2) and a demonstrated low to moderate hazard for endocrine disruption (Tier 3). However, its profile for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive, environmental, inhalation, oral, and organ/systemic hazards is currently data deficient (Tier 4).
Q2: 1,1,1,2-tetrachloro-2-fluoroethane is not currently found on the evaluated lists of concern or low hazard. This absence may be attributed to a general lack of comprehensive study, as indicated by its many data-deficient hazard tiers, or limited widespread use of the material.
Q3: While 1,1,1,2-tetrachloro-2-fluoroethane has a well-defined molecular formula (C2HCl4F) and is classified as a small molecule, it is poorly characterized regarding its hazard profile. This is evident from 6 out of 7 hazard classes being data deficient and only 35 scientific references in SciFinder, a number significantly lower than the median for chemicals in our evaluated dataset.
